decision: Commercial Intake, Director Client Access, Opportunity Manager and Sales Stage Configuration checks read holds(); authority and remount keys carry grantOf(...).assignmentId and permissionSetVersion where they carried the per-bundle pair; the Offer panel key keeps the Offer Preparer assignment and version and the permissions of both Offer bundles; the commercial PDF reads the Offer and Contract through holdsOfferRead and holdsContractRead
why: The registry gives each permission to exactly these bundles, and a live grant always has a non-blank assignment and a registry version, so each check holds for the same registry-consistent actors; commercial commands send no captured assignment or version

decision: An Intake list with the Client association but without next-action editing takes v3, the first version with the association; a Client read without an assignment takes v1 with a synthetic id; an Offer read without preparation takes the Offer Approver v1 grant
why: No registry version confers those exact lists; the chosen version adds only permissions the tests do not assert absent

decision: Unknown captured Client or Intake versions are asserted as a refusal of the whole current Actor through readCurrentActor instead of an overview-only denial
why: The current Actor parser refuses an unknown grant for the whole Actor (#1332), as #1381 and #1385 did

decision: App tests and mocked browser specs keep their per-bundle Client and Intake fields beside the grants; component tests of the migrated screens and every fixture drop the Opportunity Manager and Sales Stage Configuration fields
why: App.tsx, the Client screens and the invoice record and external invoice authorities still read the Client and Intake fields; nothing reads the manager or stage fields any more
evidence: the allowlist of #1333 after this change
